title: Explore Canvas
subtitle: Your own infinite canvas: ask freely, learn freely, explore freely, doodle freely
moveToTrashBody: "{{title}}" will go to trash and can be restored within 30 days.
emptyList: No canvases yet — create one at the top right
organizeBody: Realign cards into rows and columns (drawings, arrows and images stay untouched).
clearBody: Current content is archived to the timeline first, so you can undo it there.
histEmpty: No snapshots yet: editing auto-archives every 30 minutes; restoring also saves current first
restoreBody: Current content will be archived first and can be restored back
statsPrivacyNote: Stats cover usage behavior only (counts and times) — never question content or canvas content. Students’ expression space stays private.
careNote: Questions expressing self-harm or suicidal thoughts are answered with a fixed care script and an alert is sent. Only student, count and time are shown here — never the question text. "Model flagged" means the risk was inferred, not stated outright.
careFlagTip: Not said outright — the model inferred the risk and sent a signal
shareTip: Create a read-only snapshot of this page for your teachers (auto-expires; revocable anytime)
shareModalTitle: Share this page with your teachers
shareNamePh: Share title (optional, defaults to canvas + page)
sharePrivacy: Teachers only see this read-only snapshot — later edits stay private; it auto-expires and you can revoke it any time in My shares.
tplTip: Publish this page into the shared template library
tplModalTitle: Publish this page as a template
tplPrivacy: A template is a starter page anyone can copy with one click; you can remove it any time.
tplDeleteConfirm: Remove this template? Copies already made are unaffected.
sharesEmptyMine: You have not shared anything yet
sharesEmptyIn: No student has shared a canvas with you yet
shareErrForbidden: This share is only visible to its owner and that student's teachers

shareErrLoad: Failed to load, try again later
